worldcombat.skill.trumpcard.summary: The last card hits hardest: throw a card at the target and let it burst on impact. The fewer PP this move has left, the heavier the throw, and the very last card leaves one full seal; it is the only ranged member of the family and the only one that reads its own resource meter as a power table.
worldcombat.skill.trumpcard.use.0: Throw a spent card as a heavy blow
worldcombat.skill.trumpcard.use.1: Keep the last card for a decisive hit
worldcombat.skill.trumpcard.use.2: Name a target from far away
A hit deals about %1$s special damage; the current spend is %2$s and %3$s cards remain after this throw, so the fewer cards remain the heavier the throw. Defence, type match-up and criticals settle on impact.

The card flies at %1$s blocks per tick toward the target or point, up to %2$s blocks, with a %3$s block hit radius; the flight ends when it finishes, bursting on an entity or shattering on the block cell it strikes.

It only steers when an enemy is selected and the sure form is on: the card steers up to %1$s degrees per tick toward the target; a hit shoves it about %2$s blocks along the flight. A thrown point/direction and the straight form never steer.
worldcombat.skill.trumpcard.sure.on: Sure form on: with an enemy selected the card steers itself and almost never misses, at the cost of a slower flight, power multiplied by 0.9 and a slightly longer preparation and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.trumpcard.sure.off: Sure form off (straight form): a faster card at full power, but it can be evaded.
worldcombat.skill.trumpcard.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; after %2$s seconds of preparation it costs %4$s PP, then %3$s seconds of recovery and a %5$s second cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.trumpcard.preference.s: On: the card steers itself and almost never misses, at the cost of a slower flight, power multiplied by 0.9 and a slightly longer preparation and cooldown. Off: a faster card at full power, but it can be evaded.
worldcombat.skill.trumpcard.preference.a: Beyond this distance it closes in instead of throwing; it is a ranged move with a generous default.
When no more than this many cards remain after the throw it throws as a decisive card that outranks other attacks (its power is near its ceiling then); raise it so more throws count as decisive.
On: while more than the ace threshold would remain after the throw it only competes at the lowest priority, saving the heavy throw for later. Off: it competes normally at every throw.
On: raise priority further when the target is below four tenths health. Off: it ranks only by the remaining cards.
On: it will leave its station under a hold order to get in range. Off: it only throws when the target is already in reach.
